title: R5: Corpus + harness build for the chosen dataset (reuse Emotion Corpus/multi-class plumbing)
description:
## Purpose

Corpus + harness build for the dataset the owner picks after R3.

## Scope

- Add a corpus entry to the frozen `Corpus` config (Emotion S1) with the chosen dataset's labels and the S starting rubric from R1.
- Loader from the manifest/cache with pool / dev / final slices (`seeded_slices`), stratified label order, leakage asserts (Emotion S2 pattern).
- Multi-class plumbing (N-1 few-shot/kNN features, real probabilities) and macro-F1 metrics/paired bootstrap from Emotion S3/S4/S6/S7; reuse, do not fork.
- Wire the R4 stakeholder (and its noisy / shuffled variants) as the comments source for the explanation arms; UNEXPLAINABLE excluded from feedback.
- Offline dry run of all R6 arms with fakes; planted replays stay byte-identical.

## Specs

loader splits disjoint and stable for a seed; corpus labels flow through every binary-constant site; explanation arms receive stakeholder comments, labels-only arm receives none; shuffled arm comments never attach to their source item; dry run completes all arms.

## Definition of done

`make test` and the unified target pass; offline dry run artifacts produced; Sonnet agents build in small steps, main session reviews diffs. Request upper bounds printed for each R6 stage.

## Cost

$0 (offline).

comments.text: Built in 9a4fde8. --corpus fomc: pool = train rows minus 43 repeated texts (1,941), dev-100 class-stratified (50/27/23) and FINAL-377 from test only (19 test rows duplicating pool text dropped), ids fomc-train-<row>/fomc-test-<row> because the CSV index column is not unique (745 repeats in train; the R3 screen's fomc-<index> ids collided on 4 of its 120 FOMC items). Seed question = exactly S.txt; arms 0, A, A-c, A-c-shuffled, A-c-noisy, F, A-c+F, CEIL (F.txt question, never refit). Offline dry run (3 rounds, all arms, fake Jev + fake stakeholder) and --final completed; Jev requests by arm (rounds): 0 400, A 600, F 1396, A-c+F 1394, CEIL 100 (A-c variants shared cached answers); final 1,885. Planted phase2-live-seed1 replays byte-identical (only workspace timestamps differ), 0 requests. Bounds: rounds all arms 11,800 Jev (> 9,500 plan ceiling, so L-R1 is split: 0,A,A-c,A-c-shuffled,A-c-noisy,CEIL = 4,900; F,A-c+F = 7,300), stakeholder <=180 calls; final 3,016. make test 479 passed; unified-flywheel-test 280 passed.
